title: Peach Melba Sorbet
description: A peachy, honey-sweetened sorbet with Greek yoghurt for creaminess. Half sorbet, half slushie — refreshing and lighter than dairy ice cream.
steps: Peel, de-stone and halve the peaches (or drain tinned). Blitz in a food processor with the honey until smooth.
Add the yoghurt and blend again until completely lump-free.
Decant into a 500ml freezer-safe container and freeze for 5 hours or overnight.
Allow to soften at room temperature for 20 minutes before serving. Top with flaked almonds or raspberry coulis.
notes: Serves 6–8. The texture is intentionally quite icy.
